children: Rainbow Children's Medicare Limited on Saturday reported a 10.93 per cent rise in net profit to  ₹83.89 crore for the July-September quarter.
The pediatric and perinatal healthcare network had posted a profit of  ₹75.62 crore in the corresponding period of the previous year, the company said in a regulatory filing.
Its revenue from operations rose 23.2 per cent to  ₹548.02 crore during the second quarter of the current fiscal year, from  ₹444.79 crore in the year-ago period, it said.
Rainbow further strengthened its presence in coastal Andhra Pradesh with the commencement of operations at its newly acquired 70-bed hospital in Nellore and a 50-bed brand new hospital in Guntur.
These additions extend Rainbow's network from Visakhapatnam to Chennai, it said in a media release.

title: Rainbow Children's Medicare Q2 results: Profit rises to ₹84 cr
